headline: Victoria mayor and council candidates make their cases as nominations open
summary: CTV reports detailed campaign priorities from Marianne Alto, Bruce McGuigan and eight council candidates, covering housing, homelessness, safety, taxes, public accountability, climate resilience, regional services, transportation and the downtown economy.

headline: Bruce McGuigan publishes mayoral campaign priorities
summary: McGuigan's candidate-owned site confirms his mayoral campaign and sets out positions on homelessness, housing, public safety, accountable government, local economic development, climate resilience and the arts. The page did not expose a publication date.

headline: Nomination period opens for Victoria Election 2026
summary: The City says nomination packages may be filed from September 1 at 9 a.m. until September 11 at 4 p.m. No Victoria mayoral or council filings appeared in the official sources checked for this update.

headline: City posts 2026 election and nomination information
summary: The City's current election page confirms October 17 as general voting day, with nominations accepted September 1–11. No nomination filing or final ballot notice was available at retrieval time.

headline: Dave Thompson says he will seek re-election
summary: Thompson's refreshed campaign site says he is running again for council. It identifies housing, safer streets, vulnerable residents and climate as developing priorities.

headline: Victoria For All launches council candidates Susan Kim and Peter Rose Gibbs
summary: The report covers an August 15 launch naming Kim and Rose Gibbs as Victoria council candidates. It summarizes the group's shared focus on community care, housing, climate and accessible public spaces; its school-board candidate is outside this monitor's scope.

headline: Shona Dion publishes council campaign priorities
summary: Dion's undated campaign page outlines positions on social and co-operative housing, climate adaptation, bicycle infrastructure, public ownership and worker safety. The item date reflects retrieval, not original publication.

headline: Marg Gardiner sets out re-election platform
summary: Gardiner's undated campaign site presents positions on policing, treatment, neighbourhood planning, zero-based budgeting and public consultation. The item date reflects retrieval, not original publication.

headline: Martin Girard publishes council campaign platform
summary: Girard's undated campaign site states positions on municipal drug policy, Indigenous rights and selected international human-rights issues. The item date reflects retrieval, not original publication.

headline: Krista Loughton launches Team Loughton 2026 site
summary: Loughton's campaign site asks voters to re-elect her and describes a supportive-housing transition proposal and a walkable 'City of Communities' approach. The page did not expose a publication date.

headline: Jerry Garcia announces Victoria council campaign
summary: Garcia's campaign announcement identifies economic growth, public safety, homelessness and fiscal responsibility as priorities for a council bid.

headline: Stephen Hammond opens re-election campaign
summary: Hammond's campaign site confirms a council re-election bid and highlights public safety, affordable taxation, practical housing measures and renter protection.

headline: Bella Lee and Jack Sandor launch council campaigns focused on housing
summary: The report introduces Lee and Sandor as council candidates and describes their shared emphasis on housing costs, public services and a city where younger residents can remain.

headline: Arthur McInnis publishes Victoria council platform
summary: McInnis's campaign presents governance, budget, housing, transportation and safety proposals, including an integrity commissioner and zero-based budgeting.

headline: Karen Rothe launches campaign for Victoria council
summary: Rothe's campaign emphasizes transparent government, downtown renewal, proactive planning and attention to municipal core services.

headline: Victoria Mayor Marianne Alto launches re-election campaign
summary: The report confirms Alto's re-election launch and outlines priorities including housing, safety, community wellbeing, parks, arts and regional policing.

headline: Wendy Bowkett launches campaign for Victoria council
summary: Bowkett's campaign sets out positions on public accountability, community safety, non-market housing, parks and local economic planning.

headline: Melissa Cseszko enters Victoria council race
summary: Cseszko's campaign focuses on downtown conditions, business vitality, municipal accountability and protection of Victoria's heritage character.

headline: Matt Dell confirms council re-election campaign
summary: Dell's campaign site confirms his re-election bid and sets out priorities on homes, a downtown library, parks, infrastructure, arts and local business.

headline: Jeremy Caradonna announces plans to seek re-election
summary: The report confirms Caradonna's re-election plans and says his developing platform centres community safety, sustainable urbanism, affordable housing and community infrastructure.
